notes: τοῖς σεβομένοις: rule 49 names an adjective or a participle as the complement that leaves nothing else to carry a supplied nominal, so the article takes 'the … persons' headed on 'persons' and the participle keeps 'devout' (rules 49, 102).
κατά in κατὰ πᾶσαν ἡμέραν is unrepresented, 'every' answering to πᾶσαν and 'day' to ἡμέραν; the two-word English forbids the compound unit rule 94 permits at 17:11.
